item.title: Coming soon... the road.cc Recommends Awards 2025/26: we’ll reveal the very best bikes, components and accessories
item.description: Starting next week, we’ll unveil a whole year’s worth of the best cycling products. From superb bikes to the finest components and accessories and top-performing clothing, join us in our celebration of cycling excellence

item.title: Wout van Aert crashes out of snowy cyclocross battle with Mathieu van der Poel; "Why would ewe do that?": Video of cyclist riding into a flock of sheep goes viral; Improving cycling safety "no longer optional"; Blessing of e-bikes + more on the live blog
item.description: It’s Friday, and Megan Huws is back to bring you the first live blog of the new year

item.title: Zefal Z Road Pack Saddle Bag
item.description: Tough, good value saddlebag with impressive waterproofing, but short on internal space 7/10

item.title: Will a bike fit make you faster in 2026? New study suggests amateur cyclists could unlock significant power gains
item.description: New study into Selle Italia's idmatch bike-fitting system reports gains in both peak and sustained power, as well as a reduction in fatigue and discomfort

item.title: Number of cyclists killed on Irish roads doubles in three years, as safety group calls for “sustained political commitment” to protect vulnerable road users
item.description: 14 cyclist fatalities were recorded in the Republic of Ireland in 2025, the fourth highest number this century, while one cyclist was killed in Northern Ireland

item.title: Highland hire scheme e-bikes covered enough miles to go round the world three times in 2025 — proof that e-bikes can boom outside of big cities
item.description: Hi-bike scheme users cover over 70,000 miles in 2025, with £188 million invested in active travel across Scotland in 2025

item.title: Teenager banned from driving for a year after breaking cyclist’s back, neck, and shoulder while distracted by sat nav
item.description: The injured cyclist told the court he wishes “no ill will” on the 19-year-old student, who was also ordered to carry out 100 hours of unpaid work

item.title: Cyclists caught running red lights in London will be given the option of watching a film about a serious collision that left a cyclist in a coma
item.description: Those stopped by police can choose between a £50 fixed penalty or watch a crash awareness film based on a real collision between a cyclist and a bus after the rider ran a red light

item.title: Bivo One 21oz Lightweight Bottle
item.description: An innovative and sustainable water bottle that works brilliantly 9/10

item.title: Leeds £12m “transformative” walking and cycle lane project set to begin
item.description: The Leeds City Links scheme will bring more than a year of roadworks as residents continue to voice frustration over delayed tram plans and unreliable public transport
